new_files.reason: Thin local ownership/routing rules for real infra/business/application boundaries; root-to-area chain limits remain enforced.

new_behavior_tests.contract: Separate process rejects imports of domains/tables/core.catalog/agent/CLI/Gateway while using real selected backend resources; no source-reading assertions.
Shared target resources survive peer close, preserve scope/PID and real acquire/release.
Explicit first-create/upgrade writes data; ordinary application open/reopen SQL trace has zero DDL; old/missing/incompatible schema fails visibly without data changes.
Existing db status/upgrade and setup create real isolated SQLite datasets, repeat safely and do not initialize during ordinary startup.
Preserve actual grant/file-owner/last-reference races and original short fenced local critical sections; no new persistent token format.
Two temporary Profiles, thread hops and wrong-owner workers retain actual source selection/denial before open.
Real SDK setup upgrades, normal startup no DDL, crypto objects and new-PID recovery; genuine Linux marker.
Real random owned schema, no SQLite connection of any form, technical transaction resource works with caller-supplied schema token.
Real PG concurrent reference publication, original locks and commit-ACK loss preserve safety with effects in application owner.
